workflow.name: RSS Scraper
workflow.description: Fetch entries from RSS/Atom/XML addresses, parse and clean, deduplicate, and output structured results.

meta.name: RSS Scraper
meta.description: Input an RSS/Atom/XML address, the workflow will fetch the raw XML, parse the entry list, clean fields, deduplicate, and limit the output quantity in the final step.

steps.name: Deduplication
Fetch Feed Data
Limit Output Count
Parse and Clean Entries
Write JSON File

feedUrl.title: Feed URL
feedUrl.description: Address of RSS/Atom/XML. It is recommended to provide a complete URL (http/https).

maxItems.title: Maximum Output Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of items to keep in the final output (default 10).

timeoutMs.title: Request Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Network request timeout for fetching Feed (default 10000).

examples.name: Blog RSS
examples.description: Most common usage: directly provide an RSS address.

examples.name: Output More Items
examples.description: When you want to get more items at once, increase maxItems.

items.title: Item List
items.description: Final output array of items (parsed, deduplicated, and limited in quantity).

feedInfo.title: Feed Info
feedInfo.description: Basic information of the Feed (such as title/link, depending on parsing results).

success.title: Success
success.description: Comprehensive judgment based on fetch/parse errors and final item count.
